svg.title: The clean attack arrow breaks over dead ends
svg.desc: Interrupt the clean retrospective arrow so dead-end marks remain visible underneath. The graphic must expose narrative selection rather than erase failed work with a tidy success path.

**Location:** `documentary-evidence-field`

**Frame:** A clean attack arrow is drawn over the action field, then broken apart to reveal the thousands of dead ends beneath it.

**Action:** Retrospective narrative is distinguished from lived search.

**Font:** `inference`

**Caption:**
> THE SUCCESSFUL CHAIN LOOKS CLEAN ONLY AFTERWARD.
> THE FINISHED ACCOUNT FOLLOWS THE STEPS THAT WORKED. THE RUNS ALSO PRODUCED DEAD ENDS, DUPLICATED EFFORT AND UNANSWERED REQUESTS. READING THE SUCCESSFUL PATH BACKWARD CAN MAKE THE POPULATION LOOK MORE DIRECTED THAN THE RECORD SUPPORTS.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — project interpretation grounded in Hugging Face's forensic reflection.

", "title": "The clean attack arrow breaks over dead ends" } }
